entities.name: Query protein 103 aa
observations: Sequence length is 103 aa; estimated molecular weight 11.63 kDa and theoretical pI 5.41.
Pfam Ppnp domain PF06865.18 spans residues 11–102 with i-Evalue 2.6e-38.
Shares 66–67% identity across essentially the full length with reviewed Leptospira pyrimidine/purine nucleoside phosphorylases.
The sequence contains a C-terminal Cys-rich motif KIVCDYCCSYL; this is a sequence feature, but metal binding is not established by the available evidence.

entities.name: Leptospira nucleoside phosphorylase
observations: Reviewed Swiss-Prot homologs Q04PM6, Q055P9, and Q72NZ6 show 66–67% identity and 97–100% query/target coverage to the query sequence.
Annotated to catalyze reversible phosphorolysis of diverse nucleosides, producing D-ribose 1-phosphate and free bases.
Reported substrates include uridine, adenosine, guanosine, cytidine, thymidine, inosine, and xanthosine.
